title: 千禧管理注资前城堡量化基金人才争夺战升级外部孵化成新趋势
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now is Bloomberg's chief hedge fund correspondent Nishon Kumar, who reported on this story. Nishon, we can talk about the overall trends in just a moment,
segments.zh: 现在连线的是彭博首席对冲基金记者Nishon Kumar，他报道了这则新闻。Nishon，我们稍后再谈整体趋势，

segments.en: but walk us through exactly what Millennium is betting on here.
segments.zh: 但先详细说说Millennium在这里押注了什么。

segments.en: So Millennium has been one of the most prolific backers of not only traders internally,
segments.zh: Millennium一直是内部交易员最积极的资助者之一，

segments.en: but going out and scooping up talent and hedge funds externally as well.
segments.zh: 同时也在外部网罗人才和对冲基金。

segments.en: Either exclusively or writing big checks to startups or the funds in existence.
segments.zh: 要么独家资助，要么给初创或现有基金开出大额支票。

segments.en: So, you know, and this has been the trend. The biggest hedge funds don't just want to hire the smartest people anymore. They are increasingly acting like I can say venture capitalists,
segments.zh: 这是趋势。大型对冲基金不再只想雇佣最聪明的人，而是越来越像风险**人，

segments.en: you know, writing this billion dollar checks to talent traders to build their own businesses outside the walls of Millenniums and many such firms right now.
segments.zh: 给有才华的交易员开出十亿美元支票，让他们在Millennium等公司之外建立自己的业务。

segments.en: What's the logic of doing that versus when you have a pod shop?
segments.zh: 这跟内部团队模式相比，逻辑是什么？

segments.en: Like, aren't they kind of effectively the same when they're running their own little pot of money, whether they're internally or externally? They are, but, you know, not every talent is
segments.zh: 他们管理自己的资金池，内外不是一样吗？确实相似，但并非所有人才都愿意加入内部，

segments.en: willing to come in house if they already run their successful businesses. It all boils down to the war for talent that has reached a point where, you know, hiring alone no longer works.
segments.zh: 如果他们已有成功业务。归根结底是人才争夺战，仅靠雇佣已行不通。

segments.en: You know, top traders are expensive. They are tied up in, you know, years and months of non-compete.
segments.zh: 顶尖交易员很贵，他们被竞业协议束缚多年。
